title: Every card on the paginated post index shows its image

arg.name: scroll_to_wizard_card
arg.script:
(() => { const c = document.querySelector("img.card-img-top[src*='wizard-on-journey']");
if (c) c.closest('.card').scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); return !!c; })()

arg.name: scroll_to_doc_scraper_card
arg.script:
(() => { const a = document.querySelector("a.card-link[href*='doc-scraper']");
if (a) a.closest('.card').scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); return !!a; })()
